summary: Dynopay Phase 3 — tested COMMAND PALETTE (merchant + admin gating), BULK ROW ACTIONS on /transactions and /pay-links, plus mobile 390 render. Admin suite skipped per request (best-effort last; preview was Cloudflare-rate-limited by the time we got there). Core bulk + palette flows PASS. One ambiguous signal around checkbox stopPropagation that needs eyes.

ui_bugs.issue: Could not find the ACTIVE-row restyle marker. After typing 'trans' and pressing ArrowDown, no element inside [data-testid="command-palette"] matches aria-selected="true" OR data-active="true" — so the gold left-accent 'active row' CSS cannot be programmatically verified. Palette still works (type/arrow/enter/Esc), but the active-row ARIA/data flag needed by tests + a11y appears missing or named differently (e.g. an internal className instead of a stable attribute).

After clicking a row checkbox, a [role="dialog"] element becomes present in the DOM on BOTH /transactions and /pay-links. The visible screenshots do NOT clearly show a slide-over panel (selection bar shows '1 selected', Export CSV still works), so this MAY be a benign MUI Popover/menu role="dialog" rather than the detail slide-over. However, a follow-up click on the pagination 'Next page' button then timed out with 'element is not visible', which is consistent with an overlay partially covering the pager. Needs a human eyeball to confirm whether the detail slide-over actually opens when a checkbox is ticked. If it does → stopPropagation is missing on the checkbox onClick.

issues: No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0). Checkboxes render in the mobile card. Layout looks clean.

verified_pass: Command palette opens via Ctrl+K and closes on Esc.
Typing 'trans' surfaces palette-item-p-transactions in a 'Pages' result.

Admin gating works both ways: with localStorage.admin_token set, 'admin' shows palette-item-ap-merchants / ap-escrow / ap-fees / ap-settings; after removeItem('admin_token') and reopening, all four admin items are gone.

/transactions renders tx-select-<id> checkboxes (10 per page). Ticking one reveals transactions-selection-bar with transactions-selection-bar-count='1 selected'. Clicking transactions-selection-bar-select-page updates count to '10 selected'. Clicking transactions-export-selected fires a client-side download of 'transactions.csv' (no error).

/pay-links renders paylink-select-<id> checkboxes (10 per page). Ticking one reveals paylinks-selection-bar with count='1 selected'. paylinks-export-selected downloads 'payment-links.csv'. paylinks-copy-selected clicks without error and surfaces a 'Copied to clipboard' toast.
Mobile 390: both /transactions and /pay-links show the new checkboxes with zero horizontal overflow.
not_verified: Gold left-accent active-row border on the command palette (no stable aria/data attribute found to inspect computed styles).
Transactions selection PERSISTENCE across pagination — pagination 'Next page' click timed out; likely overlay or wrong selector, see HIGH bug above.

Dark mode visual pass on /transactions and /pay-links — Cloudflare threw 429s + MIME-type 'text/html' on JS/CSS chunks after the second navigation burst, so the dark pages never finished hydrating. (preview rate-limit, not a code bug — same preview is noted as Cloudflare-rate-limited in the request.)
ADMIN SUITE (/admin/merchants, /admin/escrow, /admin/fee-reconciliation) — explicitly flagged as best-effort last; skipped due to session rate-limit after bulk-actions pass.
action_items: Confirm checkbox stopPropagation on both TransactionsTable row checkbox and PaymentLinksTable row checkbox — ticking must NOT open the detail slide-over. Add e.stopPropagation() on the Checkbox onClick (and ideally onChange) if missing.

Expose a stable attribute on the active row of CommandPalette (aria-selected="true" or data-active="true") so the gold-left-accent restyle can be verified by tests + screen readers can announce the active option.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkbox cells inside a clickable row MUST call e.stopPropagation() in BOTH onClick AND onChange — React forwards onChange via a change event that can still trigger parent onClick in some MUI setups.

CommandPalette: the restyled 'active row' should set aria-selected on the listbox option (role=option under a role=listbox) for a11y + testability — a className-only highlight is invisible to tests and screen readers.
